§2Pam's HarvestCraft §f is an extremely diverse food mod that has a lot of different foods for you to eat and thus keep your diet varied 
with.

§5reduce the value of your current food§f and make your diet worse.

So you should probably make an underground farm of sorts to grow crops easily.
